questions.text: How is speech handled: browser speech (Web Speech API, no backend) or a speech provider called through the API?
questions.reason: REQ-434 leaves this open. A provider means the api application is also touched; browser speech keeps the work in web only.

questions.text: Which 2D avatar animation assets should the interviewer use?
options: Create simple placeholder animations in the project
questions.reason: REQ-434 says '2D animation assets' without naming them, and the idle, speaking and listening states depend on them.
questions.answer: Create simple placeholder animations in the project

questions.text: When TTS is unavailable on a device, what does the replay/mute control show?
options: Hide the audio controls; text only
Show the controls disabled with a short message
questions.reason: REQ-434 requires the question text to stay visible but does not say what happens to the audio controls.
questions.answer: Show the controls disabled with a short message
